ios.desc:
XQuest is a multiplayer game for conversation in real time. Record your video question, answer, rate and choose.

HOW IT WORKS:
1. Choose the type of video question 
You can choose text or voice type of question.
2. Record your question
Come up with an interesting question and record it for participants of the opposite gender.
3. Wait for all players
People from the same location and of the same age will play with you. The game will start automatically when six players - three guys and three girls - come together.*
4. First Round - Answer the questions
During the first round girls answer questions asked by guys and vice versa. The time for the first round - 3 minutes.
5. Second Round - Rate the answers to your question
In the second round each player rates the answers from opposite gender. The time for the second round - 1 minute 30 seconds. 
6. Final Round - Liking
In the last round the players select persons they liked most of all or vote against all players.
7. Find out the results of the game
When the time of the final round expires, you can find out the results of the game. If a boy and a girl select each other - they are added into X-list.

Each player gets the scores for each game. The scores are calculated based on his/her answers and selection of the players. 
The user’s rating in the application depends on these scores.

---------------------------------------------
Please note! 
*If you have enabled push-notification, you will receive a message when the game is ready.
---------------------------------------------
